text.en:
The amount of Thirty Million Pesos (P30 M) is hereby appropriated from the funds of the
National Treasury and otherwise appropriated to the National Economic and Development Authority, as
custodian of the IGLF, in order to augment the resources of the Industrial Guarantee and Loan Fund to be
administered by the Central Bank of the Philippines.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
